title: Beethoven — Piano Sonata No. 8, Op. 13 (Pathétique)

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia 2009/09/13-299, 2011/10/25-295, 2013/01/08-296, Chris Sawer after Berners 1908 / Winterberger and G. Schirmer 1894). Local zip is the three movement MIDIs, not a Mutopia-hosted archive.

movements.name: I. Grave — Allegro di molto e con brio

editionNotes: Movement I opens Grave in 4/4 (MIDI quarter=33) then Allegro in 2/2 (half=144). Both have four quarter-notes per bar, so a single 4/4 grid matches the MIDI. Movement III is 2/2 with a dotted-quarter pickup (LilyPond \partial 4.).

The local reference zip is eval/cache/downloads/pathetique-mids.zip (pathetique-1.mid + pathetique-2.mid + pathetique-3.mid). Do not run fetch against the MIDI url in reference.url — that field only satisfies the mutopia schema.
Do not embed document UUIDs. --from document cannot --out a baseline-* oracle.
The 19-page hosted scan used for the shootout is not vendored; pdf.sha256 is intentionally unset. Shootout must reuse the hosted PDF bytes.
